summary: Recognise the portal error page that ISIS returns for an over-wide date range, and re-run the search over sub-periods instead of reporting an empty result.
reason: Past a certain document count the engine refuses the query and answers with an error page (message ko / QR997) carrying no result-count block. Search discarded the bootstrap body, so the refusal was parsed as zero rows and presented as a fact about the archive - a wide range answered with fewer acts than a narrow one inside it.
